name: 4457-ratesweep-mixtral8x7bfp8-4gpu
parallelism: TP=4, PP=1, one in-process vLLM engine. No router, no external cache tier.
architecture: Sparse mixture-of-experts decoder, 46.7B parameters (~93 GB bf16), 32 layers, 8 experts per layer with 2 routed per token.
load_profile: constant rate (OPEN loop), 10 req/s, 500 requests, safety 1800 s, warmup sized at the first 10% of requests.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no prefix bucket. Prompt exactly 1000 tokens and output exactly 50 (min = max on both), faker-generated prose, every prompt distinct. `request_format: plain` is declared in scenario.json so 1000 tokens reach the engine; the backend default `default-template` would wrap the prompt and send 1008.
purpose: A document-analysis assistant returning brief answers from thousand-token briefs, ten requests a second across four GPUs.
launch:
model: mistralai/Mixtral-8x7B-Instruct-v0.1
dtype: bfloat16
tensor-parallel-size: 4
quantization: fp8
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
block-size: 16
max-num-seqs: 256
seed: 0
max-model-len: 4096
